tool.name: CheckScheduleReadiness

param.name: outputs
param.displayname: Outputs of the Tool to Schedule
param.dialogReference: The output files or folders of the tool you will schedule, typed exactly as you will enter them in that tool. The check reads each folder (it does not need the file to exist), tests that it is writable, and tells you whether the name has the %t% time stamp. Without %t% every run overwrites the same file.

param.name: inputs
param.displayname: Inputs of the Tool to Schedule
param.dialogReference: The input datasets of the tool you will schedule. A scheduled run reads the saved project, not what is open in ArcGIS Pro, so Esri recommends the full path to each dataset instead of a map layer. A layer from a map fails the check, and the message gives the full path to use instead.

param.name: check_signin
param.displayname: Test Portal Sign-In Outside ArcGIS Pro
param.dialogReference:
• Checked (default): starts a new Python process with no window, the way a scheduled run does, and connects with GIS("pro"). It passes only if ArcGIS Pro stored your sign-in (Sign in automatically). The user name, portal URL and token are never shown.

  • Unchecked: no sign-in test (for tools that do not use a portal).

param.name: out_report
param.dialogReference: An optional CSV file with one row per check: check, status (PASS, WARN or FAIL) and note.

param.name: ready
param.dialogReference: True when no check failed. Warnings do not stop a schedule.

tool.summary: Checks what a scheduled run needs before you use Run > Schedule: a portal sign-in that works outside ArcGIS Pro, full dataset paths for inputs, writable output folders, and the %t% time stamp in output names. It changes nothing and creates no schedule.
tool.usage:
• Run it with the same inputs and outputs you will give the tool you schedule.

  • A scheduled tool runs in its own Python process from Windows Task Scheduler, while ArcGIS Pro may be closed, and only while you are signed in to Windows.

  • With a Named User license, sign in to ArcGIS Pro with Sign in automatically checked, or a scheduled tool that uses your portal cannot sign in.

  • Add %t% to an output name (for example Report_%t%.csv) to get a new file every run; without it the file is overwritten.

dataIdInfo.idPurp: Check a tool's inputs, outputs and sign-in before you schedule it.
